title: Content SEO
description: Whether a page's content earns the ranking: clear purpose, intent match, depth, keyword coverage, freshness, and E-E-A-T signals.

items.check: Page has one primary purpose (educate, compare, sell, support, onboard, retain).
items.pass_criteria: A single dominant intent is evident.

items.check: Content matches the search intent of its target keyword.
items.pass_criteria: Format/angle matches SERP intent for the primary keyword.
Covers the subtopics competitors cover; no thin content.

items.check: Primary and secondary keywords appear naturally.
items.pass_criteria: Primary in title/H1/intro; secondaries in body; no stuffing.

items.check: Content is current and dated where relevant.
items.pass_criteria: Updated within an appropriate window for the topic.
Author, credentials, first-hand evidence, or sources shown.

items.check: Page links to related internal content.
